objectives.title: Technical and Organizational Measures Governance
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding technical and organizational processing controls.
criteria: Specifications defining implemented technical and organizational measures.
Protocols reviewing technical and organizational measures.
Mechanisms updating technical and organizational measures.
Evidence demonstrating that processing is performed in accordance with the Regulation.

objectives.title: Data Protection Policies
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding formal data protection policies.
criteria: Commitments establishing formal data protection policies.
Provisions governing data protection policy implementation.
Data protection policies scoped appropriately to the nature and risk of processing activities.

objectives.title: Independent Compliance Demonstration
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding external mechanisms proving regulatory adherence.
criteria: Provisions referencing approved codes of conduct.
Recognition that such adherence is one element, not sole proof, of demonstrating compliance.
